question: What is Human Edge Press and why are your books 100% screen-free?
answer: Human Edge Press is an independent children's publisher headquartered in Austin, Texas ('Analog Roots First, Digital Wings Later'). We publish 100% physical, neuroscience-backed books for ages 0–8—including High-Contrast Baby Board Books (ages 0–2), Ethan Finch's STEAM Alphabet Board Books (ages 2–4), Pre-K Workbooks (ages 3–5), and The Human Edge Hardcover Virtue Series (ages 3–7)—designed with Socratic parent prompts to build deep focus, curiosity, and character without apps, QR codes, or batteries.

question: Which Human Edge Press books fit my child's age (newborn, toddler, preschool, or early elementary)?
answer: Our catalog is organized by developmental stage: • Ages 0–2 (Stage 1): High-Contrast Baby Board Books (6 titles + Newborn Sensory Starter 3-Book Box Set) for visual tracking and serve-and-return bonding. • Ages 2–4 (Stage 2): STEAM Alphabet Board Books (Science, Technology, Engineering, Art, Math + 3-Book Box Set) plus upcoming Oddlings Workbooks (ages 2–5). • Ages 3–5 (Pre-K): Big Pre-K Learning Workbook + upcoming First Think First Words (ages 4–5). • Ages 3–7 (Stage 3): The Human Edge Hardcover Virtue Series (12 child-and-animal storybooks with parent prompts + 5-Book Core Box Set). • Ages 0–7 Complete Library: The 23-Book Master Developmental Library Chest ($199.99).

question: How much does shipping cost and how fast do Human Edge Press orders arrive?
answer: Orders placed Monday–Friday are packed in protective eco-friendly packaging and dispatched within 1–2 business days (24–48 hours) with real-time email tracking. Standard US Ground transit is 3–5 business days: $4.99 flat rate on smaller orders, and FREE US Standard Shipping on qualifying orders ($49+ per /pages/shipping; $50+ noted in the site header—every multi-book Box Set and the Master Chest qualify automatically).

question: What is your return policy and 30-Day Family Guarantee?
answer: Every physical book is backed by our 30-Day Family Guarantee: you may request a 100% refund or exchange within 30 days of delivery with $0.00 return shipping and restocking (free prepaid return label) and 3–5 business day refund processing. Items must be in new, unused condition with no missing pages, writing, or permanent marks; contact support@humanedgepress.com with your order number or checkout email.

question: Do you offer wholesale or bulk orders for schools, libraries, Montessori classrooms, and homeschool co-ops?
answer: Yes! Human Edge Press supports bulk orders for preschools, elementary classrooms, public/church libraries, pediatric clinics, and homeschool co-ops. Reach our Austin team via https://humanedgepress.com/pages/contact (select 'Wholesale, Library & Homeschool Co-op Orders') or email support@humanedgepress.com (average response time under 24 hours).

question: How do the parent conversation prompts inside The Human Edge Series work?
answer: Every hardcover in The Human Edge Series (ages 3–7) pairs an engaging everyday story featuring a child-and-animal duo (like Caleb & Retriever in 'Kind' or Zuri & Robin in 'Brave') with 3 open-ended 'Read Together' conversation prompts for parents—moving naturally from story observation to empathy to a real-world action your child can try tomorrow, with zero preachy lecturing.
